title: A store this build does not recognize is called corrupt and told to restore or re-initialize
outcome: A store carrying schema this build does not own is described as what it is, so nobody destroys live work by following the refusal text; the refusal stays a refusal and still never opens or mutates such a store
acceptance: Opening a store with schema objects this build does not own refuses with text that names running the build that owns the store, and never names re-initialization or restoring a backup as the remedy
Regression: a store carrying one extra index this build does not own reproduces both surfaces, and a genuinely corrupt store still reports corruption

doctor and projection repair on the same store do not assert that its durable state is invalid or classify it as a corrupt store; the machine-readable code distinguishes unrecognized schema from corruption
